implementation.status: Fallback stacks, not bundled fonts or extracted reference-site font names.
implementation.loading: If selecting a licensed brand font later, self-host or use the existing framework font pipeline; provide a fallback and font-display strategy.
implementation.wrapping: Use natural wraps; do not force desktop line breaks on mobile. Let controls grow if long translated labels need it.
implementation.metrics: Check fallback width, italic descenders, and layout shifts after font loading. Serif display has at least 1.1 line height.
implementation.responsive: Use rem plus viewport terms with clamp; verify actual browser text zoom and narrow reflow.
